nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, the chi-square law with $p$ degrees of freedom is the gamma law on $\mathbb{R}$ with shape $p/2$ and rate $1/2$ (equivalently, scale $2$): the measure with density $x \mapsto \frac{(1/2)^{p/2}}{\Gamma(p/2)} x^{p/2 - 1} e^{-x/2}$ for $x > 0$ and $0$ for $x < 0$ with respect to Lebesgue measure.
nodes.title: Chi-square distribution

nodes.summary: The square of a standard normal variable is chi-square with one degree of freedom, as an identity of measures on `ℝ`. (Moved here from the likelihood-ratio development so that both that development and Cochran's theorem reuse one declaration.)
nodes.title: The square of a standard normal variable is chi-square with one degree of freedom

nodes.summary: Let $\gamma$ be the standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb{R}$ (mean $0$, variance $1$) and let $\nu$ be its image under $x \mapsto x^2$. For every real $t < 1/2$, the function $y \mapsto e^{t y}$ is integrable with respect to $\nu$.
nodes.title: Exponential moments of the law of the square of a standard normal

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a positive integer and let $\chi^2_p$ be the chi-square law with $p$ degrees of freedom. For every real $t < 1/2$, the function $x \mapsto e^{t x}$ is integrable with respect to $\chi^2_p$.
nodes.title: Exponential moments of the chi-square distribution

nodes.summary: Let $\gamma$ be the standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb{R}$ (mean $0$, variance $1$). For every real $t < 1/2$, the function $x \mapsto e^{t x^2}$ is integrable with respect to $\gamma$.
nodes.title: Exponential moments of the square of a standard normal

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a positive integer and let $\chi^2_p$ be the chi-square law with $p$ degrees of freedom. For every real $t < 1/2$, $\int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{t x} \, d\chi^2_p(x) = \left(\frac{1/2}{1/2 - t}\right)^{p/2}$.
nodes.title: Moment generating function of the chi-square distribution

nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be the gamma law on $\mathbb{R}$ with shape $1/2$ and rate $1/2$. For every real $t < 1/2$, $\int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{t x} \, d\mu(x) = 1/\sqrt{1 - 2t}$.
nodes.title: Moment generating function of the gamma law with shape and rate one half

nodes.summary: Let $\gamma$ be the standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb{R}$ (mean $0$, variance $1$) and let $\nu$ be its image under $x \mapsto x^2$. For every real $t$, $\int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{t y} \, d\nu(y) = 1/\sqrt{1 - 2t}$.
nodes.title: Moment generating function of the law of the square of a standard normal

nodes.summary: Let $\gamma$ be the standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb{R}$ (mean $0$, variance $1$). For every real $t$, $\int_{\mathbb{R}} e^{t x^2} \, d\gamma(x) = 1/\sqrt{1 - 2t}$.
nodes.title: Moment generating function of the square of a standard normal

nodes.summary: Chi-square MGFs multiply by adding degrees, below `1/2`. Requires a nonempty index set so the summed degree stays positive.
nodes.title: Chi-square moment generating functions multiply by adding degrees

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
